ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Windows Strings In URI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious Windows strings in URI which could indicate possible exfiltration or webshell communication Note: Unmapped fields: cs-uri-query

sequences.query: (cs-uri-query = RGX(".*\\=C\\:\\/Users.*") OR cs-uri-query = RGX(".*\\=C\\:\\/Program\\%20Files.*") OR cs-uri-query = RGX(".*\\=C\\:\\/Windows.*") OR cs-uri-query = RGX(".*\\=C\\%3A\\%5CUsers.*") OR cs-uri-query = RGX(".*\\=C\\%3A\\%5CProgram\\%20Files.*") OR cs-uri-query = RGX(".*\\=C\\%3A\\%5CWindows.*"))
